packageRules.description: The setup-go pin in ci.yml is a deliberate correctness constraint, not staleness: golang.org/x/text picks its Unicode tables by toolchain build tag, so a Go 1.27 toolchain silently switches this package's normalisation to the Unicode 17 tables and the differential oracle against MRI fails. Renovate proposed exactly that in #9. The advisory oracle-stable-toolchain job is what tracks the newer toolchain, without gating. Unpin here only once golang.org/x/text is fixed upstream (golang/go#81001).
